entry.title: New: dsh-vision-plugin
entry.summary: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README). Exact install spec: github:ld-1101/dsh-vision-plugin. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
